notes.title: Patch [7/30] V. 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

*Removed knockback when getting hit by enemies to avoid the getting stuck in walls bug.
*Changed the opening and ending cutscenes with animated improvements and addition to the story.
*Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Bug Fixes Patch [7/3]
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

*Crash when entering stairs in Dungeon 2
*Gamepad glitches where fireballs wouldn't fire
*Fixed bug that wasn't allow users to delete a save file in the menu

More fixes to come.

notes.title: Minor Patch [5/21/19]
notes.notes:
Minor patch released today.

*Minor Bug fixes:
    - Few game crash spots
    - Never ending magic upgrade

notes.title: Another Patch in May.
notes.notes: I will be working on another patch next month to try to repair the dungeon crash issue. I haven't been able to get it to crash on my machine so I can't figure out what is causing it.

notes.title: Patch coming this weekend
notes.notes: I've had trouble getting this game and Cosmic Bounty patched because the computer I developed them on died and my new computer doesn't like GMS1 which was used to make them. I was running on Windows 8 while the new one runs on Windows 10 and have been getting hair pulling problems. This week I did manage to get some work done finally which includes a fix to the achievements not working. I still need to do work on the key mapping so for the meantime I just have a WSAD and Arrow Keys system working simultaneously. I haven't fixed the dungeon spawn problem yet. I thought it was fixed with the first patch but errors were still reported. It is on the agenda for fixes this week.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 Released
notes.notes:
Patch Fixes Include:

*Dungeon entrance deleting spawn fixed
*Keyboard not working fixed (temp fix: Have to use a fixed scheme, custom keyboard configuration won't read. Still working on that but the default scheme will work.)
